title: Talk about yesterday
description: Repeat past tense phrases, then describe your day.

items.targetText: Yesterday I went to the shop.
items.hint: Past Simple of go is went
Past Simple of buy is bought

items.prompt: Say two things you did yesterday.
items.promptIt: Di' due cose che hai fatto ieri.
items.exampleAnswer: Yesterday I went to the park. I bought some bread.
items.hint: Use went or bought with yesterday
